name: Redirect settings
subtitle: How broken links are recorded, and what the plugin offers when it finds one.

elements.label: Record paths that lead nowhere
elements.hint: Switch off once a migration is finished and you no longer want the evidence. Redirects keep working either way.

elements.label: Suggest destinations
elements.hint: Look through live pages, products, posts and collections for a path close to the broken one.

elements.label: How close a suggestion must be (%)
elements.hint: Below about 60 the suggestions stop being useful and start being noise you have to read and reject.

elements.label: Remove dealt-with entries after (days)
elements.hint: Used by Prune history on the Broken Links screen. Nothing is ever removed automatically, and open entries are never removed at all.

elements.label: Show suggestions to visitors on the 404 page
elements.hint: Requires the active theme to include the plugin's not-found slot. A theme that does not renders nothing at all — see the plugin's README.

elements.label: Never record these paths
elements.hint: Wildcards, one per row: wp-admin/*, *.php, .env. Without these the list fills with vulnerability scanners probing for software you do not run, and the real broken links are buried.
